titleEn: Today, December 09/2018, the Regional Public Service and Human Resources Development Bureau (RSHRD) members held a meeting with the heads of the Bureau of the Regional Government.
titleAm: ዛሬ፣ ታህሳስ 09/2018፣ የክልሉ የህዝብ አገልግሎት እና የሰው ሀብት ልማት ቢሮ (RSHRD) አባላት ከክልሉ መንግስት ቢሮ ኃላፊዎች ጋር ስብሰባ አካሂደዋል።
titleAa: Asaakih Ayro, Qado Dirrik 09/2018 I.L.L Doolatak Sadar Ayfaf Kee Sahdayti Caylih Daddoosih Kutbeh Buxah Adoytit Rakaakayak Doolat Kutbeh Buxah Saqolti Lih Walal Gexsen.
excerptEn: Today, December 09/2018, the Regional Public Service and Human Resources Development Bureau (RSHRD) members held a meeting with the heads of the Bureau of the Regional Government.
excerptAm: ዛሬ፣ ታህሳስ 09/2018፣ የክልሉ የህዝብ አገልግሎት እና የሰው ሀብት ልማት ቢሮ (RSHRD) አባላት ከክልሉ መንግስት ቢሮ ኃላፊዎች ጋር ስብሰባ አካሂደዋል።
excerptAa: Asaakih Ayro, Qado Dirrik 09/2018 I.L.L Doolatak Sadar Ayfaf Kee Sahdayti Caylih Daddoosih Kutbeh Buxah Adoytit Rakaakayak Doolat Kutbeh Buxah Saqolti Lih Walal Gexsen.
bodyEn:
Today, July 09/2018, the Management Committee of the Regional Public Service and Human Resources Development Bureau (RHRH) held a meeting with the members of the Regional Government. After a discussion on the 2% increase in the salary, the meeting voted to increase the salary of the Bureau's Deputy Chairman, Mr. Qellama Abobakar.

/uploads/news/july-16/747807940_1005611589007163_1482408192896931064_n.jpg
bodyAm:
ዛሬ ሐምሌ 09/2018 የክልሉ የህዝብ አገልግሎት እና የሰው ሀብት ልማት ቢሮ (RHRH) የአስተዳደር ኮሚቴ ከክልሉ መንግስት አባላት ጋር ስብሰባ አድርጓል። በደመወዝ ጭማሪው ላይ በ2% ውይይት ከተደረገ በኋላ፣ ስብሰባው የቢሮው ምክትል ሊቀመንበር አቶ ቄላማ አቦባካር የደመወዝ ጭማሪ እንዲደረግ ድምጽ ሰጥቷል።

/uploads/news/july-16/747807940_1005611589007163_1482408192896931064_n.jpg
bodyAa:
Asaakih Ayro, Qado Dirrik 09/2018 I.L.L Doolatak Sadar Ayfaf Kee Sahdayti Caylih Daddoosih Kutbeh Buxah Adoytit Rakaakayak Doolat Kutbeh Buxah Saqolti Lih Walal Gexsen. Qasbi ossotina 2% wagittaamal yekke walalak lakal kutbeh buxak ciggiila saqal gifta Elama Abobakar qasbi ossotina axcuk dooro abe.
